title: no-space-before-semi doesn’t check for all semicolons

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
There are several cases where a semicolon can occur which is not checked by `no-space-before-semi`.

Here are a few failing tests for this rule which should have an error:

``` js
invalid: [ 
      { code: "while (true) { break ; }", errors: 1},
      { code: "while (true) { continue ; }", errors: 1},
      { code: "debugger ;", errors: 1},
      { code: "function foo() { return ; }", errors: 1},
      { code: "throw new Error('foo') ;", errors: 1},
      { code: "for (var i = 0 ; i < 10 ; i++) {}", errors:2 },
      // ...
]
```

Result:

```
  1) no-space-before-semi while (true) { break ; }:
     AssertionError: Should have 1 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 1

  2) no-space-before-semi while (true) { continue ; }:
     AssertionError: Should have 1 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 1

  3) no-space-before-semi debugger ;:
     AssertionError: Should have 1 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 1

  4) no-space-before-semi function foo() { return ; }:
     AssertionError: Should have 1 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 1

  5) no-space-before-semi throw new Error('foo') ;:
     AssertionError: Should have 1 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 1

  6) no-space-before-semi for (var i = 0 ; i < 10 ; i++) {}:
     AssertionError: Should have 2 errors but had 0: []: expected 0 to equal 2
```
